description:
Manage the economic-operator parties on a passport (manufacturer, importer, authorisedRepresentative, distributor, recycler, producerResponsibilityOrg). Each carries a legal name and an identifier.

A party needs at least one of `gln`, `legacyOperatorId` or `operatorIdentifier` (EN 18219 §6.2–6.5; they must agree if both gln forms are given, else 400). Identifier shapes: resource tracepass://reference/parties.

Actions (pass via `action`; `{…}` is the `args` object):
- set — { id, role, legalName, gln?, country?, url?, tradeName?, postalAddress?, email?, legacyOperatorId?, operatorIdentifier?, facilityIdentifier? }. tradeName, postalAddress and email are public; for a battery importer they are its Battery Regulation Art. 41(3) details.
- remove — { id, role }.

After a battery passport is placed on the market, changing a stored operatorIdentifier or facilityIdentifier returns 409 operator_locked; other edits stay allowed.

email.description: Company contact, not a person's. Public.

facilityIdentifier.description: Same schemes as operatorIdentifier; gln also takes `extension`.

role.description: Economic-operator role: manufacturer | importer | authorisedRepresentative | distributor | recycler | producerResponsibilityOrg (required).

name: tracepass_passport_parties
title: TracePass passport parties
